description.narrative: ltpgtACF has been implementing lifesaving nutrition and health activities in Borno state since 2014 among vulnerable populations in both IDPs and host communities. In response to the dire situation in the lean season of 2025, ACF plans to implement this emergency nutrition and health response in 4 LGAs of Borno state to urgently address the malnutrition situation through IMAM, psychosocial support including IMCI consultation for children. under five for common illnesses. ltbrgtThe project will target 46,008 direct beneficiaries (74% female), primarily focusing on children under 5 and pregnant and lactating women (PLW). ACF will work with relevant stakeholders by expanding the bed capacity based on the evolving admission trend, human resources and pharmaceuticals support to the existing ACF supported stabilization center (SC) in MMC-Fatima Ali Sheriff (70 beds) and Gubio GH SC (22 beds) and across the 7 PHC centers. ACF will also reopen the 24-bed capacity in MCH Gajiram in Nganzai previously supported by ACF in 2023/2024 for the treatment of complicated SAM cases and case management of diseases outbreak such as measles.ltbrgtACF will provide operational and technical support to these three SCs, capacity building, psychosocial support, provision and preposition of therapeutic milk, drugs, SAM kits and equipment including beds required for effective management of children U5 having SAM with complications at the SCs hosted in these LGAs. To address access barriers, early discharge and opportunity cost by the caregivers accessing SC, ACF will provide transport and three balanced nutritious meal for caretakers and their children. ACF will work with WHO and relevant local government authorities to upscale routine immunization for vaccine-preventable diseases and reduce the defaulter rate through outreach services.ltbrgtACF will scale up IMAM services in 7 OTPs in the 4 LGAs and establish 2 mobile teams (1 Nganzai and 1 Gubio) to increase service coverage in underserved communities. The health component will complement the nutrition objectives by providing treatment for common illnesses associated with severely malnourished children following the ACF single care pathway approach on IMAM, IMCI, routine vaccination and provide MIYCN counseling at the health facility and community levels. ACF will leverage on the RUTF and MNP in its Buffer stock program to ensure consistent pipeline of nutritional consumables in case of the main pipeline breakage. ltbrgtThe project will establish 14 mother support groups across the 4 LGAs, led by a lead mother comprising 10 persons. Trained CHIPS agents will coordinate the community group activities. The supplemental nutrition assistance (Tombrown approach) will be carried out by establishing 28 Tombrown groups (4 groups per Health facility catchment area), and will be led by a health promoter and receive weekly in-kind food recipes for 4 months (16 rounds). These groups will meet weekly to prepare Tombrown flour and distribute a 1.5kg weekly ration to MAM children for a maximum of 12 weeks. The community health workers will support in taking anthropometry measurements, provide counseling on complementary feeding, check vaccination status and refer MAM children including relapsed cases for medical treatment.ltbrgtHealth workers, mothers and caregivers will be trained on key thematic subjects such as IMCI, outbreak prevention and response, inpatient care, PSEA/GBV, family MUAC to improve coverage and quality of care. In addition, CHWs will provide group and one-on-one counselling in breastfeeding spaces at the health facilities, while children 6-59 months will receive vitamin-A and be dewormed.ltbrgtlt/pgt
